report.markdown:
# Height Comparison of Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower

## Height Comparison

The Burj Khalifa is taller than the Shanghai Tower, with one source reporting its total height as 829.8 meters or 2,722 feet and its architectural height as 828 meters or 2,717 feet. [1] One source reports that the Shanghai Tower has a height of 632 meters or 2,073 feet. [2]

## Sources

1. [Burj Khalifa - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burj_Khalifa) — wikipedia.org, published 2004-07-07, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [25 Interesting Facts about Shanghai Tower - Fact Bud](https://factbud.com?p=8158) — factbud.com, published 2024-08-22, fetched 2026-10-31
